name: Rebekah's coffin
description: An ornate coffin.  Your little sister.  A silver dagger in the heart keeps them in a dead sleep.  Examine it to pull the dagger out.

description: An ornate coffin.  The reckless youngest brother.  A silver dagger in the heart keeps them in a dead sleep.  Examine it to pull the dagger out.

description: An ornate coffin.  The eldest, who hates what he is.  A silver dagger in the heart keeps them in a dead sleep.  Examine it to pull the dagger out.

name: painting of a Norse village
description: An old oil painting of a Viking village in the snow, painted in Niklaus's hand.  It hangs very slightly crooked.  Behind it, set into the wall, is a heavy locked safe.
